title: No Water to Drink
text: They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

title: Give Us Water
text: So the people contended with Moses, “Give us water to drink.”

title: Die of Thirst?
text: Why have you brought us out of Egypt—to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?

title: A Little More and They Will Stone Me
text: What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!

title: Walk On Ahead
text: Walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with you.

title: I Will Stand Before You
text: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb.

title: Water Out of the Rock
text: And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.

title: Massah and Meribah
text: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD …

title: The Spiritual Rock
text: … for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.

title: Living Water
text: If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.

title: Water for the People
text: … water will come out of it for the people to drink.

title: The Amalekites Attacked
text: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.

title: Joshua Fought
text: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites …

title: Hands Up
text: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed …

title: Hands Down
text: … but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.

title: A Stone to Sit On
text: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it.

title: Steady Until Sundown
text: Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.

title: Joshua Overwhelmed Them
text: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.

title: Write This on a Scroll
text: Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua …

title: The LORD Is My Banner
text: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.

title: Hur
text: Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side …

title: Our Children Too
text: … to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?

title: And Our Livestock
text: … to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?
